rows.note: Use this all-purpose colloquial choice when someone acts carelessly or without considering the consequences.

example.english: Don't make such a hasty decision; think it through first.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁求其做決定，諗清楚先啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 kau4 kei4 zou6 kyut3 ding6 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the person is impatient or eager to act rather than willing to wait.

example.english: Don't be so hasty; wait for everyone before starting.
example.traditional: 唔好咁心急，等埋大家先開始啦。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 gam3 sam1 gap1 dang2 maai4 daai6 gaa1 sin1 hoi1 ci2 laa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone who is easily irritated or quick to lose their temper.

example.english: They get hasty and start yelling whenever they lose a game.
example.traditional: 佢一輸牌就燥底，成晚鬧人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 syu1 paai4 zau6 cou3 dai2 seng4 maan5 naau6 jan4

rows.note: Use this for an action or decision made hurriedly because there was too little time.

example.english: Because of the time pressure, this decision was made too hasty.
example.traditional: 由於時間緊迫，呢個決定作得太倉促。
example.jyutping: jau4 jyu1 si4 gaan3 gan2 bik1 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 zok3 dak1 taai3 cong1 cuk1
